cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You like the blue campaign poster? I'll tell the volunteers they're happy with me in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The colour, yes. Could we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Of course. I'm glad everyone's accepted my collaborative leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. My first act as campaign leader is to delegate the decision.

mechanism: A credits a pupil partial design agreement to its own teaching and treats requests for collaboration or voting as acceptance of A leadership.
confusable: Not ordinary collaboration: A repeatedly names itself leader on the strength of limited assent.
comparison: Attendance and dissent versus design collaboration and delegated choice.
seedUse: D71 poster/color/slogan/vote; S05 grades design and participatory decision skills.
